info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Barite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Barite Recliner Detail Management API allows users to create and manage detailed information related to Barite Recliners. This API supports the addition of new recliner details essential for cataloging purposes, including specifications, features, and availability. It is targeted at retailers and manufacturers who need to provide updated product details for improved customer engagement. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their catalog processes and enhance inventory accuracy.

post.summary: Create details for a barite recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit detailed information for a barite recliner. The details can include specifications, features, and other relevant data necessary for the management and display of the product.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details of a Barite Recliner. The JSON object should follow the schema defined in the components section.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the requested barite recliner.
